style: point the listener to one word to listen for

candidates.angle: the two tat-tva, truths, of knowing and entering
bhakti, the love that reveals the fullness of the divine

en.intro: Krishna has finished describing the calm devotee, and now he points to the heart of bhakti. Listen for the word that names this direct knowing.
en.notice: Listen for the word abhijanati, knows truly. It is not ordinary knowledge, but a deep recognition that reveals exactly how much Krishna is and what he is.
en.next: Krishna now speaks of the devotee who takes refuge in him, acting in the world yet entering the eternal state.
en.meaning: Through devoted love, one truly knows Me as I am. Knowing Me in truth, one enters into Me at once.

hi.meaning: उस पराभक्ति से मेरेको, मैं जितना हूँ और जो हूँ, इसको तत्त्व से जान लेता है तथा मेरेको तत्त्व से जानकर फिर तुरंत मेरे में प्रविष्ट हो जाता है ॥
hi.next: कृष्ण अब उस भक्त की बात करते हैं जो मुझमें शरण लेता है, संसार में कर्म करते हुए भी मेरी कृपा से शाश्वत और अविनाशी पद को प्राप्त होता है।
